items.definition:
highest in rank or authority
He has supreme authority in the company.

peaceful; calm
The pacific nature of the village made it a perfect retreat.

first in importance, order, or rank
The company is a premier provider of software solutions.

relating to the observation and treatment of patients
The new drug is undergoing clinical trials.

half; partly
The project is semi-finished.

superior; best
Only an elite group of athletes qualifies for the Olympics.

relating to an established set of principles governing a state
The new law was declared unconstitutional.

relating to or affecting the fundamental nature of something; far-reaching or thorough
The company underwent a radical change in management.

of considerable importance, size, or worth
They made a substantial donation to the charity.

relating to laws or the making of laws
The legislative body passed a new bill.

relating to the mind and mental states
The accident had a significant psychological impact on her.

holy, heavenly
Many cultures believe in a divine power.

serving to regulate
The company must comply with all regulatory requirements.

extreme, beyond
He is an ultra marathon runner, completing races over 100 miles.

relating to an empire
The Imperial Palace is a famous landmark.

relating to a congress
The congressional hearing lasted all day.

belonging to each of the people or things previously mentioned
They returned to their respective homes.

having the power to advise
The committee has an advisory role.

following one after another continuously
This is our third consecutive win.

relating to a parliament
The parliamentary debate lasted for hours.

involving or causing a complete or dramatic change
The invention of the internet was a revolutionary development.

native; originating in a place
The indigenous people have lived here for centuries.

introductory; prior to main event
The preliminary results were promising.

relating to courts of law or judges
The judicial system ensures justice.

statistical
The report presented statistical data.

excellent or British currency
He made a sterling effort to finish the project on time.

relating to the reign of Queen Victoria (1837–1901) or to the art, architecture, or customs of that period
The house had beautiful Victorian architecture.

relating to or involving the mental processes of knowing, perceiving, remembering, and reasoning
The study examined the cognitive development of children.

relating to or consisting of molecules
Scientists are studying the molecular structure of the virus.

of or concerning a province of a country or empire; unsophisticated or narrow-minded
She found the small town rather provincial.

so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe
She noticed a subtle change in his mood.

fierce, violent, and uncontrolled
The critics launched a savage attack on the new film.

having dimensions
We are studying three-dimensional shapes in math class.

concerned with beauty
The painting had great aesthetic appeal.

severe or bare in appearance or outline; complete
The room was stark and empty.

relating to a large and important organization, such as a university or bank
The report highlighted institutional racism within the system.

in the intervening period; temporary
The company appointed an interim CEO.

crucial
Her support was instrumental in the success of the project.

including all types of people or things
The school promotes an inclusive environment.

relating to strategy
They made a tactical decision to retreat.

too many to be counted; innumerable
There are countless stars in the night sky.

dead
The deceased's family gathered for the funeral.

stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt
He gave explicit instructions on how to assemble the furniture.

necessary to make a whole complete; essential or fundamental
Trust is an integral part of any strong relationship.

connected with the sea, especially in relation to seafaring commercial or military activity
The city has a rich maritime history.

famous
He is a renowned scientist in his field.

capable of working successfully
The plan is not economically viable.

relating to, composed of, or involving two things
Computers use binary code.

relating to philosophy
He has a very philosophical approach to life.

not religious or spiritual
The country has a secular government.

possessing supreme power; independent
The country is a sovereign state.

very great or intense; deep
His speech had a profound impact on the audience.

strong and healthy; sturdy
The company has a robust economy.

conforming to what is generally accepted as right or true
He holds very orthodox views on education.

likely to suffer from or do something
He is prone to accidents.

relating to or contained in the Bible
Many stories have biblical origins.

relating to medicinal drugs, or their preparation, use, or sale
The pharmaceutical industry develops new medicines.

supernatural
They investigated the supernatural events in the old house.

relating to young people; immature
The court deals with juvenile offenders.

likely to happen at a future date; potential
We interviewed several prospective candidates for the job.

relating to mental illness or its treatment
He received psychiatric evaluation after the incident.

robust; capable of enduring difficult conditions
These plants are very hardy and can survive cold winters.

functioning or having an effect
The new policy will be operative from next month.

inspiring respect and admiration; having high status
Harvard is a prestigious university.
